hook: Eritrea's all-out invasion of the Tigray region has shocked Ethiopia into filing an emergency UN complaint.

sections.voiceover: Eritrea's all-out invasion of the Tigray region has shocked Ethiopia into filing an emergency UN complaint.
b_roll: Map showing the border between Eritrea and Ethiopia

sections.voiceover: On October 9, Foreign Minister Gedion Timothewos sent an official letter to the United Nations Security Council. Ethiopian military vehicles and troops entered Adigrat near the border. Where will this conflict lead?
Foreign Minister Gedion Timothewos called the military incursion a blatant act of aggression.
Ethiopia filed the official letter regarding Tigray at the United Nations.
